blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Nic Cabanero and Gilas Pilipinas begin their medal bid in the men’s U-23 basketball 3×3 competitions of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 with two games slated for Monday. The MPBL star will be joined by UAAP standouts Koji Buenaflor, Luis Pablo and David Dungo when they take on Mongolia at 11:50 a.m. Manila time and Sri Lanka at 1:55 p.m. in Pool A. Gilas will be facing Kazakhstan on Wednesday to wrap up pool play at Kinjo-futo Station Square. The group winner will gain a direct entry into […]...
